name: Someone Said Yoga?
source:
An F95zone user embarks on an epic journey into virtual infinity and beyond.​

[From F95zone]

A (not so useful) guide about making 3D games with Ren'py based on F95 Zone users' opinions. Enjoy and learn!
translation:
一位F95zone用户踏上了一段史诗般的旅途，前往无穷无尽的虚拟世界，乃至更遥远的地方。

[摘自F95zone]

这是一份根据F95zone用户意见编写的Ren’Py3D游戏制作指南，虽然可能没什么用。边玩边学吧！
